name: City Dweller
description: Equipping this paint lets your enemies know that you are a respectable city-dwelling tanker who cares about traffic management and makes use of public transport... before politely blowing up their tank as a gentle reminder that they should use public transport next time.
interestingFacts: This paint was added to the game on March 6th, 2020.
This paint was available by completing a special mission, earning 15 000 experience points in any matchmaking mode or map between March 6th-10th.
